description: Switches the reading direction of the surrounding content.

examples.label: Example 1
examples.code: Use the direction button to switch this paragraph between left-to-right and right-to-left layout.

attributes.name: anchor
attributes.description: CSS selector used as the explicit element that receives the selected direction.

attributes.name: mode
attributes.description: Reading-direction mode (`ltr`, `rtl`, `auto`). In `auto`, RTL is inferred from language or supported region codes.

attributes.name: size
attributes.description: Size preset forwarded to the trigger icon button: xxs, xs, s, m, l, xl or xxl.

attributes.name: variant
attributes.description: Color variant forwarded to the trigger icon button: neutral, brand, success, danger, warning or info.

events.name: tp-dir-change
events.description: Emitted when the reading direction applied to a target changes.
events.detail: { mode: "ltr" | "rtl" | "auto"; dir: "ltr" | "rtl"; anchor: string; target: HTMLElement }

dependencies.name: tp-base
dependencies.summary: Shared base class for tp-* components.

dependencies.name: tp-divider
dependencies.summary: Visual separator for menus, dropdowns, toolbars, and layouts.

dependencies.name: tp-icon
dependencies.summary: SVG icon component with inline, URL, and registry sources.

userHelp.introduction: The custom `<tp-dir>` element switches the reading direction of the surrounding content.
userHelp.interactions:
#### Mouse interactions

| Control or gesture | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Using the component | Activate the direction button to change the reading direction of the associated content. |

#### Keyboard interactions

| Key or gesture | Result |
| --- | --- |
| <kbd>Tab</kbd> / <kbd>Shift</kbd>+<kbd>Tab</kbd> | Move between the available controls. |
| Focused controls | Use each control’s standard keyboard interaction.  |
| <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>?</kbd> | Open User Help for the component under the pointer, or the focused component if none is hovered. Include <kbd>Shift</kbd> if needed to type <kbd>?</kbd>. |
| <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>Alt</kbd>+<kbd>?</kbd> | Choose a component from the hierarchy under the pointer, or around the focused component, then open its help. <kbd>Alt</kbd> is <kbd>Option</kbd> on macOS; include <kbd>Shift</kbd> if needed to type <kbd>?</kbd>. |
